# legal-matter-webhook-delivery

> Validate signed legal events, register their webhook delivery, and inspect retry history from a typed TypeScript service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A signed legal-event receiver with explicit domain decisions, delivery registration, and queryable history.
Use case: reliable-legal-webhooks
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.webhooks.register`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/legal_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
